title: Fix Back returning to the wrong scroll position
request: Doug: 'Yes scroll fix' (answering: fix the shared scroll-restore hook so Back from a team page returns to the same scroll position, as found while polishing the History page)

criteria.text: History: Back after a team link restores the exact scroll position in 10 of 10 runs with the data cached and 10 of 10 after a reload of the team page (real browser, 390px, fake data; before: 3/10 and 2/10)
criteria.evidence: Measured 2026-11-06, History 390px, fake data, fresh browser per run, within 1px of the offset before the click: dev server cached 10 of 10 observed, after a reload of the team page 10 of 10, slow phone (CPU x4, delayed data) 6 of 6; production build cached 10 of 10 and reload 10 of 10. Same scripts before the fix: 6 of 10 and 2 of 10 this round (earlier runs 3 of 10 and 2 of 10; production build 7 of 10 and 5 of 10). Lead spot check on the final code: cached 4 of 4, reload 4 of 4, reduced-motion reload 3 of 3. Saved offset equalled the offset before the click in every after-fix run. Files: .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/SUMMARY-after2.txt, .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/SUMMARY-all.txt. Safari/iOS not tested.

criteria.text: Same at 1280px, and /stats, /teams and /insights still restore after a team link (or are marked not tried if the fake data has no link)
criteria.evidence: 1280px: cached 5 of 5 observed, reload 5 of 5 (before 5 of 5 and 3 of 5). /teams 390px: 5 of 5 at offset 304 (round 1 had regressed to 0 of 5, fixed by the watch window) and 5 of 5 runs across offsets 100/200/250 (two, two and one runs). /stats 1 of 1 after a team link and /insights 1 of 1 after a footer link (/contact): /insights was NOT tried with a team link, the fake data has none there. Lead: bottom tab bar (Schedule) then Back at 390px, /stats, /teams, /insights 3 of 3 each after the fix. Same test on the OLD hook (lead, before/OLD-top-*.json): /stats 3 of 3, /insights 3 of 3, /teams 0 of 3 (landed at 86px, saved offset right). Files: .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/SUMMARY-after2.txt, .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/before/OLD-top-teams.json.

criteria.text: A reader who scrolls while a slow restore is still waiting is not pulled back, and Back no longer glides from the top
criteria.evidence: Reader takes over, 390px, slow list: wheel 3 of 3 observed with no hook scrollTo after the event and scrollY unchanged; wheel during the 1 s watch window 3 of 3; scrollbar press at 1280px (classic 15px scrollbar, headless Chromium): pointerdown reached window 3 of 3 and the restore stopped. Control runs without a reader kept trying. Back no longer glides: distinct frame values 0 then the saved offset in 3 of 3 traced runs (before: 0,3,19,81,93,101,105,108,110,111); with reduced motion 0,111,900 where 111 comes before the hook's jump (the hook's only scrollTo call was made when the position read 111; its source is not shown). Saving is back on 4 s after the restore in every set. Files: .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/after2/dev-glide*.out, .factory/evidence/T-261106-fix-back-returning-to-th/after2/dev-reader-*.json. Safari/iOS not tested; find-in-page, screen reader and voice control send no input event (restore can fight them while it runs, read from code, not tried).

reviews.summary: Independent plan review. Both causes real and complete, no third cause found; no reason to reject. Cause 2 arithmetic verified (1153-844=309, hook line 85 tests scrollHeight >= saved, page shell is min-h-dvh so the test is almost always true). Cause 1: router changes window.location.pathname before any DOM swap, so a pathname guard is correct whatever React's cleanup timing. Three blocking repairs accepted and written into the plan as AMENDMENTS: (1) one stop() helper with a cancelled flag and the rAF id, called from exhaustion, user input and cleanup, so an unmounted page can never scroll the next page (test + mutation); (2) test plan repairs: global scrollTo stub in setupTests, clamp stub must accept both call shapes, fake rAF/cancelAnimationFrame, userEvent under fake timers, jsdom path is / while the router is /history, no exported constants (knip), fractional case; (3) acceptance: report n of n observed, assert the saved offset equals the pre-click scrollY in every run, scrollTo spy, vary offsets, also run the production build, add a CPU/network throttle run. Non-blocking adopted: capture the path at effect start for the guard; reword Cause 1 to what was measured; try/catch fallback for behavior instant (iOS 16.0 Safari unverified, WebKit not installed); keydown ignores repeat. Could not verify: browser behaviour, scrollbar pointerdown, iOS 16 instant, lint on new code.

Independent code review at 50ee277: code APPROVED in substance (no logic defect found; StrictMode, cleanup order, timers, listeners, isRestoring stuck-true all traced; 43 of 43 tests pass; no old test changed). Two BLOCKING doc errors: (1) '5 of 5 at each of 100/200/250px' was false, the file holds 5 runs in total (two, two, one); (2) the 'ScrollToTop glides on a link tap' finding is not shown by the saved frames (900,111,25,0 with 91 frames, identical with reduced motion; the '20' came from a scratch note), so it was stated beyond the evidence in 17 places. Also: 'fixed' credited where the old code did not fail (BROWSE-04, BROWSE-37, TEAM-33, PHONE-22), a self-contradiction in navigation.md, lead evidence only in scratch, small gaps (Ctrl/Cmd+F sends keydown; touch/key tested in unit tests only). Optional code notes accepted as documented limits: unreachable saved spot keeps saving off up to about 15 s unless the reader scrolls; scrolls that send no input event can be pulled back while the restore runs; the cancelled flag is redundant with cancelAnimationFrame/clearTimeout.

Independent code review, final verdict at head ce13c13 (docs-only commits on top of the reviewed hook commit bf63233; src unchanged, git diff bf63233 ce13c13 -- src is empty). Four rounds: round 1 CHANGES (2 blocking doc errors: '5 of 5 at each of 100/200/250' was 5 runs in total; the link-tap 'glide' was not shown by the frames, same with reduced motion), round 2 APPROVE with non-blocking points (/stats run used a team link, not a footer link; headline lacked the late-data exception), round 3 CHANGES (every-case lines, causal 'fix' wording, retries cap), round 4 CHANGES (one phrase: 'three seconds late' vs one quiet second, three at most), final APPROVE. The hook was found sound in every round: no logic defect (StrictMode, cleanup order, timers, listeners, isRestoring cannot stick true), 43 of 43 tests, no old test changed, 1,958 items and 115 P1 suspected-bug rows recounted, 2,751 links 0 broken. Accepted limits (documented): unreachable saved spot retries about 15 s with saving off unless the reader scrolls; scrolls with no input event can be pulled back while the restore runs; late data after the watch window is not caught; the cancelled flag is redundant belt-and-braces. Safari/iOS, real phones, real networks, Forward in a browser, a closed tab are UNKNOWN.
